description: Read to-dos: actionable steps, standalone or under a goal, with linked goal and calendar sessions. due_date null means no due date, never today and never overdue. view: open (default), undated, unscheduled, upcoming, overdue, done, all. todo_id reads one; goal_id or query filters. Page with offset from next_offset. ($0.01; API key required)

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging, e.g. 0.

query.description: Words in the title or notes.

todo_id.description: Exact id from get_todos or create_todo. Titles are not accepted.

view.description: Which to-dos to list: open, undated, unscheduled, upcoming, overdue, done or all, e.g. open.

name: get_todos
title: Get To-dos
